articles.title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
articles.content: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

articles.title_zh: 多式联运:嵌入空间语言和视野的统一流动模式
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了多种方式流动,一种完全连续的语言和远见的遗传模式。 大多数统一的多模式模型要么将语言和被量化的图像作为离散符号来模型,要么将离散语言预测和连续的图像生成结合起来. 前者引入了视觉量化瓶颈. 后者要求有基于模式的目标和取样程序。 完全连续的建模可以避免这些取舍,并能够共享基因过程,但对于多式联运的预先培训仍然未得到充分探讨。 多式联运 流量引入了统一的连续结构,将多式连续表示与共享的块-原因流量主干结合起来。 它将文本块和图像组织为所订购的连续超圆形,维护了文字符号顺序和视觉空间结构. 骨干通过"流相匹配"(Flow Matching)在这些超Chunk上学习出一个单向量场. 联合关注可促进跨模式互动,而模式特定的向信息传输网络处理每一种模式。 该模型预测在训练期间平行的多个目标块,并在推论中相继生成超充. 我们对MF-1进行即时分析,并对其进行多式联运数据的预先培训。 在0.6B、1.2B和1.6B尺度上,持续的预训不断改进多式联运模式。 由于只有150B预训符,MF-1在GenEval和DPG-Bench之间平均得分为82.8分,在VQAv2,MMBench和POPE之间平均得分为75.3分,仍然具有竞争力,在大量数据方面接受了统一模型的培训. 在匹配数据、优化和参数预算下, " 多式联运 " 进一步超过了具有代表性的混合模型和离散模型。 这些结果建立了以块为基础的连续嵌入流模型,作为统一多式联运模型的新的完全连续的模式。 相关的代码和模型在https://github.com/hustvl/Multimate-Flow上公开发布.

articles.title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.

articles.title_zh: 快速优化多式联运临床诊断
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)正在迅速推进临床诊断,但其适应性管道仍然以基于准确性的目标为主。 临床数据严重阶级不平衡:常数占多数的预测器在临床上无用的同时,可以得分超过90%的准确度. 因此,我们对AUROC进行评估并优化,这是一个无门槛分数,将正数排在负数上,对分数平衡无变化. 我们专注于MLLMs的即时优化. GEPA等反射方法使用二进制分数矩阵,每个评价实例一行一列,每个候选人一列即时;单元格记录每列正确性,因此列平均值为准确性并驱动候选人选择. 我们引入了对等的帕雷托即时演化(Ranking-PE),它将每个正确行替换为对等的排列行,取而代之的是(正,负)例对:如果考生的正分数高于对等负分,则单元格为 1. 列平均值随后等于实证AUROC(由Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney身份). 我们在所有三个层次上应用这个交换, 即时进化搜索读取的分数矩阵 决定帕雷托的统治权, 反射LM的每个实例反馈, 以及最后的候选人选择, 在MIMIC的三种疾病中,基于精度的即时进化可以降低排名; Ranking-PE反之,以+5.8 AUROC pp在微调的Qune3-VL-8B和+16.2 pp上在MedGemma-4B上击败了基于精度的配方. 校正检查了每个设计部分,并表明医疗级视觉主干-通过视觉-编码器调整的SFT或医学预训-是及时搜索无法取代的一个先决条件-我们的食谱将反映性地从文本数据迅速发展到多模式临床决策。

articles.title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
articles.content: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

articles.title_zh: Physis-Lang:自演语言作为视频世界模型的实际代表
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型预计会预测物理世界是如何演变的,然而它们却经常产生视觉上可信的视频,违反基本的物理原则. 现有方法通常认为,自然语言不足以代表可靠生成所需的物理知识,因此引入了额外的以视觉、潜在、数字或规划为基础的信号。 我们重新审视这一假设,并引入了Physis-Lang,这是一个自我演变的框架,它将物理语言作为数据整理、模型培训和视频生成方面的共同和可选择的代表。 Physis-Lang通过描述其相关实体、原因、相互作用、指导原则、时间演变和影响的语言,代表物理过程。 为了改进这种表述,我们构建了PhysCap Bench,它将物理过程分解为原子论断并用回想和精度来评价标题. 一个代理环路迭代地分析断言级错误并完善用于制作物理标题的指令. Physis-Lang进一步将模型缺陷转换为文字描述,并使用语言引导检索来识别覆盖缺失物理过程的视觉多样性视频. 以万通和宇宙骨干对被广泛使用的四种物理视频基准进行的实验表明,物理可信度不断提高。 值得注意的是,从开源Cosmos3-Nano骨干开始,我们的Physis-Lang-增强型模型超越了领先的专有Veo 3.1型.

articles.title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
articles.content: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

articles.title_zh: ViTeX-Bench:高密度基准 视频场景文本编辑
articles.content_zh: 近期的视频生成越来越现实,并且可以控制,然而视频编辑仍然不够发达,尤其是对于当地准确的,必须保留原景动态的编辑. 视频场景文本编辑取代了场景表面的文本,如存储前台标志,白板和产品标签等,同时保留了周围的内容,运动,相机动态. 虽然场景文本编辑对于图像的研究很好,但实现高视觉质量,时间一致性,编辑地点的视频场景文本编辑仍然没有得到充分利用. 现有资源提供的对等真实录像数据有限,一般视频编辑指标无法直接衡量所请求的文本在一段时间内是否正确。 我们引入了ViTeX-Bench,一个包含ViTeX-Dataset的基准套件和一个三轴评价协议. 该数据集包含387个真实世界的720p视频,并带有文字区域口罩和编辑指令:230提供经过审查,由管道生成的对接编辑供培训使用,157组成了被冻结的评价分拆. 协议评价文本的正确性、视觉质量和时间质量,并通过13个度量衡进行局部编辑,每个度量衡有一个主度量衡,并比较它们的取舍。 OCR校正,人的评价,以及注释敏感性分析都支持对这些分数的解释. 4个编辑家庭的8个基线、准确的文本、时间稳定性和现场保护仍然难以共同实现。 我们还发布了ViTeX-Edit-14B,一个开源参考编辑器在对接的训练分解上用运动相通的glyph-video调制进行了微调. 它实现了CharAcc 0.688,在被评价的视频本土编辑器中为最高的平均值,在原始编辑器产出中为最低的可比较的文本剪接曲. ViTeX-Bench为在视频场景文本编辑中研究这些取舍提供了一个可复制的基础.

articles.title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
articles.content: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: Assembly World:与大会目的代理人一起反思三维大会
articles.content_zh: 三维组装的任务需要将对部件及其关系的理解转化为精确的空间安排. 预先训练的通用剂能否通过视觉交互来组装物体而无需额外的组装特定微调? 为了调查这一问题,我们介绍了AssemblyWorld,这是一种互动的三维环境,在这种环境中,特工人员在有图像或装配手册的情况下检查观点并操纵所提供的僵硬部件。 代理通过2D视图来感知部分几何,而不是直接接触网顶或面,而其产生的集合则通过几何评价. 在这个环境的基础上,我们建造了AssemblyWorld Bench, 包括100个组装任务, 覆盖80个物体, 包括家具、工业组装和断裂再组装。 对8个代理系统进行评价后发现,它们的能力大相径庭。 最强的系统实现了80.9%的部分精度,但59.4%的全组装成功. 所评价的开源系统在执行可靠性和组装准确性方面都远远落后于其较强的开源系统。 对视觉参考、相互作用轨迹和失败的分析显示,物剂在留下剩余定位错误的同时如何修正组件。 AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配代理的能力和描述大约结构恢复与准确重建之间的差距提供了一个共同的环境。

articles.title: Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners
articles.content: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

articles.title_zh: 图像分类器是高效的自我监督视频代理学习者
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了VideoMSN, 是一个蒙面暹罗网络框架, 我们不依靠重的3D架构或基于重建的自定义编码器来学习无标签的数据,而是通过将视频作为超级图像来代表标准图像Vision Transformers,这是由从视频中取样的帧组成的网格. 从每个超级图像中,我们构建出两种观点:一种是空间补丁遮盖,另一种是时间框架遮盖,确保信息不会跨帧泄露. 一个共享的ViT变形器(ViT)编码器使用被蒙住的暹罗损失来校正它们的嵌入,在不重建的情况下捕获了运动和外观提示. 我们的解码器免费配制利用了图像基础模型,促进高效的视频表现学习. 从预先训练的DINO-v3和DeiT-v3图像编码器开始,VideoMSN在Kinetics-400,UCF101和HMDB51上实现了最先进的性能,同时与之前的视频自导自演的学习方法相比,需要更少到32\times$和160\times$. 我们提议的办法还显示出低射分级的有力表现,证实在标签匮乏的情况下,学到的表述是可以转移的。 项目网页:https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn。

articles.title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
articles.content: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.

articles.title_zh: Ego4WAM:在扩大以Egocent为中心的人的数据用于机器人学习时,有什么关系?
articles.content_zh: 以Egocent为核心的人类数据为机器人学习提供了可扩展的经验来源,但在人-机器人对接,行为覆盖和可用监督方面差异很大. 现有工作显示,随着人类数据的增加,其规模是有利的,但仍不清楚哪些数据属性能推动下游机器人的发展以及如何在整个培训过程中使用这些数据。 我们提出了对以自我为中心的人类数据的系统研究,在一个统一的世界行动模式框架下进行不同的调整和监督。 随着模型主干网的固定,我们解开人与机器人对接,数据持续时间和任务多样性,动作监督,以及数据使用策略的影响. 我们发现,调整后的人类演示大大改进了分配外的通俗化,并减少了目标任务机器人数据要求;数据持续时间和任务多样性对下游能力的影响不同;并且仅限视频监督仍然有效,没有行动标签,为随后的视频行动培训奠定了坚实的基础. 我们通过对真正的机器人和机器人的封闭式政策评价来验证这些结果。 Ego4WAM没有将数据持续时间作为唯一的缩放轴,而是展示了对齐,任务多样性,可用监督和使用策略如何共同塑造了以自我为中心的人类数据对于机器人学习的价值.

articles.title: I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video
articles.content: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

articles.title_zh: 我有一个流:让自我监督的学习在连续视频上发挥作用
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的学习从婴儿的视觉发育中汲取了灵感,然而标准的培训管道与它几乎没有任何相似之处:图像是独立的样本,并且在全球各个时代被打乱. 我们研究从连续的视频流中进行自我监督的学习,在视频流中,帧按时间顺序被消耗,使用严格的滑动-窗口分批,不进行全球重排或多时代重放. 为此,我们建造了WT++,一个95小时的城市行走-旅游视频数据集,用于溪流预训. 结合一个全面的评估套件,我们发现,在这种环境下,具有对比性和以蒸馏为基础的方法会挣扎,而MAE则更强健,但仍然没有达到标准,即预先培训。 我们发现,由于连续几批次的窗外滑动而导致的高度相近性并不能解释这一差距。 主要的挑战是批内相似度高,每批中的帧相近重复. 为了缓解这种情况,我们建议采用StreamMAE, 保留了StreamMAE的核心重建目标,同时使投入管道适应于流感常态化和有运动偏见的作物选择。 StreamMAE超越了流线基线,匹配了同一视频数据培训的MAE,与ImageNet预训的MAE保持了竞争力,随着预训流从12小时增长到95小时,尺度也呈正比.

articles.title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
articles.content: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MatLoom: 压缩程序空间中按层排列的文本到元件生成
articles.content_zh: 材料的生成不仅应产生外观,而且还应产生构成这种外观的规则。 我们引入了MatLoom,一种紧凑的,面向层次的语言,用于文本到材料的生成,并带有经过预先训练的语言模型. 每个程序都由α-大块地层组成,其共享的空间表达方式定义了覆盖面和物理渲染(PBR)通道,使图案,颜色,和解脱之间的依赖性明确. 一个独立的解释器将程序评价成材料地图,而源则保留了被命名的字段和地层参数,供后续作者使用. 我们的管道没有针对特定任务的微调,就使用解剖仪制导的修复和基于预览的批评来修改材料设计,然后搜索噪音种子,同时固定每个候选者的剩余来源。 在以6个主干线评估的141个快件的全方位基准上,我们最佳配置的平均得分高于所有4个平放即时对接指标的3个传播基线。 在批评或种子搜索之前,其初始程序已经超过了平均BLIPScore的所有三个基线。 保留程序在跨骨干集合时的中位长度为21行. 在涉及30个参与者和20个提示的盲目四向比较中,我们得到了59.2%的选择,而最受欢迎的基准为19.3%。 因此,契约可执行程序提供了一种方法,既可以生成迅速对齐的材料,又可以保留其建筑作为资产的一部分。

articles.title: Atomizer-IO: Beyond Pixels, Patches and Grids
articles.content: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 原子- IO: 超越像素、 补丁和网格
articles.content_zh: 大多数视觉结构假设观测位于一个正常的网格上,对自然图像是有效的抽象,但对遥感数据是限制性的,其信道、时间取样、空间分辨率和几何可以有所不同。 通用集成架构去除网格,但也去除有用的空间诱导偏差. 我们引入了Atomier-IO,一种将观测放在首位的架构,并从它们的物理关系中衍生出结构. 在对数据进行原子表示的基础上,每个观测都通过测量和获取元数据进行描述,而局部交叉观察则将观测图绘制到可任意放置的锚点上. 我们通过逐渐放松网格假设来评价这种设计,从不同的输入光栅配置和不完全的信道集到灵活的输出密度,最终是没有光栅网的输入. Atomier-IO在大多数任务上具有具有灵活的针对道德操守办公室的架构的竞争力,同时提供对推论成本的培训后控制和竞争性计算-性能取舍。 同一配体没有进行建筑重新设计而延伸至无序的3D点云,表明原子界面一般化于常规光栅输入外. 这些结果表明,像素,补丁,和网格不需要定义一个感知结构的界面.

articles.title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
articles.content: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GLARE:产生有适当反应的听众头
articles.content_zh: 虽然说话的头代已经迅速进步,但是在dyadic对话中产生自然的倾听者行为,这些倾听者知道何时反应,如何反应,以及用何种反应,仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 现有的dyadic数据集缺乏精细的收听者反应说明,从谈话头和视频生成中继承的流行的评价度量衡量视觉现实性,而不是收听者是否作出适当的反应. 我们从三个方面处理这些差距。 首先,我们整理一个由RealTalk和Seam Interactive制作的针对听众的数据集,其中包含大约147小时的对齐的演讲者-听众视频,以及64,557个事件级反应说明,涉及6个类别:点头,头摇晃,微笑,取笑,皱眉和出人意料. 其次,我们引入了以流相匹配变压器即GLARE所建的音频驱动基线,由Qune2-Audio所衍生出活性调节并明确监督帧式反应的时间反应损失. 第三,我们提出面向反应的评价协议,联合测量反应的发生(R-F1)、时间对接(R-tIoU)、不对称时间偏差(R-ATD)和反应区域视觉质量(R-FID),提供比视觉质量仅能衡量的基于行为的评估。 实验结果显示,在视觉忠贞度和反应水平的度量上,与先前的听头方法相比,都取得了一致的收益,这表明反应意识数据,建模,评价对于自然听觉行为至关重要.

articles.title: Looped Diffusion Transformer
articles.content: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 循环扩散变形器
articles.content_zh: 改进文本到图像模型传统上依赖不断增大的模型大小或去名步骤的数量. 在这项工作中,我们探索一种可选择的尺度计算方法,在每个去诺步骤内反复运行共享变形器块,在保持参数计数不变的同时,有效提高计算深度. 这种循环计算使得内部表述的反复完善没有明确的推理符号. 然而,天真地循环未能持续地改善图像质量. 我们追查这一问题的原因是,中间循环监管不力,而且注意更新不受管制,逐渐侵蚀当地信息。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提出"循环分化变换器"(Looped-DIT),它将跨中间循环的深度监督与自调性注意力结合起来来稳定循环特性更新. 在相匹配参数和相匹配计算设置下,Looped-DiT的性能始终超过非用铁接通的基线. 值得注意的是,260M参数的回转模型可以超越多个文本到图像基准的6.5x更大的模型,同时需要4.9x更低的推论计算. 除了这种性能增益之外,我们发现循环计算可以为扩散模型提供更有效的迭代计算形式,不断提高的循环深度产生更大的收益,而不是在固定的推论预算下增加更多的去名步骤. 此外,更深入的循环可以逐渐地纠正先前循环中的错误,表现出暗示潜在推理的行为. 这些结果表明,循环计算为视觉生成模型的尺度化提供了有希望的途径。

articles.title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
articles.content: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计算机SD:从实时反馈中在线自我分离,用于计算机使用代理
articles.content_zh: 在线培训使计算机使用代理人能够通过与可执行环境的相互作用来改进。 然而,现有方法主要依靠微薄的结果回报,这些回报不能对中间行动进行监督。 政策自消(OPSD)通过特权回分数提供象征性的学习信号,但直接将其应用于CUA在线培训带来了两个挑战:固定指导可能与学生的目前状态错配,而由指导引起的概率转移可能与分级正确相冲突. 我们引入了ComputerSD,一种用于CUA的在线自消化方法,将执行的GUI过渡的实时反馈转化为政策学习指南. 微调的GUI分析器在每次动作后都会产生指向和分级值分;指向提供了特权上下文,而分数则会调节由此产生的OPSD信号. 计算机 SD在一个完全同步的训练框架内联合优化了符号级OPSD和轨迹级GRPO. 在OSWorld-Verification上,计算机SD在通用的Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking和专用的EvoCUA-8B骨干上分别以1.9分和4.1分的优于结果的GRPO. 在分配外环境下的评价进一步支持了"计算机可持续发展"的通俗性. 这些结果表明,通过网上自我消化向海关协调会学习实时反馈是有效的。

articles.title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
articles.content: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StreamRig:探索内相几何来流多卡美拉 测量
articles.content_zh: 移动机器人和车辆搭载了同步多相机钻机,然而许多流式3D地基模型都是为单相机输入而设计的,使得钻机几何的高效使用成为了挑战. 我们提出StreamRig,一个冻结和流出的框架,在被冻结的多视图3D地基模型上为被校正的钻机构建出因果流出odometer. 被冻结的前端共同通过钻机校正来感知同步视图. 一台Rig-Resampler压缩了它们的特性,一台CausalBridge应用了有键值缓存的因果注意,而轻量级头部倒置了钻机. 定期重排协议支持对长序列的平面估计。 只有这些模块得到了培训,总共74.6M参数,相对构成唯一的监督。 我们的两阶段训练战略结合了团体再定位预训和因果钻机训练,将被冻结的前端的几何前缀和被预先训练的模块的对接能力转移至流出odometry. 我们评价NCLT,TartanGround,KITTI-360,以及我们自己收集的人造机器人数据集ZJH,其中训练只使用模拟,而现实世界的评价是零镜头. 在所有四个数据集中,StreamRig实现的翻译和自转漂移比评价的非甲骨文单体流和钻机感离线模型要低,同时保持了较低的推论成本. 故障和控制相机计数实验确定了这些收益的来源。 我们进一步审查较长的培训窗口如何影响较长视野的推断。 代码已在https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig发布.

articles.title: EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance
articles.content: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model's parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases \textit{perception under insufficient evidence} and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models. The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL. All code, models, and data are released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EviRover: 强化外观
articles.content_zh: 视觉感知通常被表述为一发一发从一发一发看图像的一发一发的预测,假设图像内容和模型的参数化知识足以解决询问. 这种假设往往在现实世界的假设中失败,这些假设依赖于精细的视觉细节,或需要知识密集型和最新信息。 我们把这类案件称为\textit{在证据不足的情况下的观念},并将这种观念定为一种代理过程,可以一目了然地获得信息。 为解决这一设置缺乏数据的问题,我们设计了两个专用的数据生成管道,生成了EviRover-SFT-5K和EviRover-RL-12K供培训使用. 我们进一步构建了EviLens系统,这是一个经人验证的基准,由5个认知类别的688个实例组成。 在这些数据的基础上,我们向大家介绍EviRover,据我们所知,第一感知剂被明确培训,通过互动,利用监督的微调,然后进行促进性强化学习,解决知觉问题。 实验显示,4B EviRover在EviLens上平均比它的骨干表现要好30分,达到了与高级专有模型相仿的性能. 收益从EviLens转移到WebEyes、常规认知基准和一般多式基准,包括改进了15分浏览器Comp-VL。 所有代码,模型,和数据都发布.

articles.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
articles.content: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LOCI:流出世界模型的空间线性记忆
articles.content_zh: 当相机重访之前观测到的区域时,视频世界模型应复制之前的图像。 这既需要记住过去的意见,也需要为当前的观点检索正确的意见。 密钥-值缓存保存可视化细节,但随着视频长度的增大而增长;经常内存是紧凑而将历史压缩为固定大小状态,因此单个过去的观测不再可以直接访问. 我们引入了LOCI,一种混合空间-记忆结构,保留了两种表达方式. 在半个变压器块中,主注意力保留了过去观测的密钥-值缓存;在另一半中,它仅限于当前块并辅以反复出现的线性留念内存,其读取和写作都以投影相机几何为条件,因此视角同时输入内存地址和存储内容. 经常读取会流入后续缓存后后置的块并用累积的场景上下文提供他们的查询. 在公开的MIND内存基准上和被搁置的已录制出轨迹上,LOCI再现的内容比有代表性的世界模型更忠实地再现,以及一个同源回转的全软相模;拥有完整的历史,相对于全软相模,它将峰值内存等长地降低约30%. 拥有一个被保留观察的有界限的库,它在恒定记忆中流出长相的视频,并且仍然比同一预算下的全软马克斯更忠实.

articles.title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.

articles.title_zh: 从历史行动轨迹学习技能:世界行动模式行动经验词典
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)将视觉动态预测与动作生成结合起来,但并不明确支持在操纵任务中重复使用动作经验。 此外,由于冗余的背景元素干扰了关键视觉信息的提取,现有的WAM努力捕捉能够指导目标动作预测的基本跨任务语义关系. 为了应对这些挑战,我们开发了一部小说"行动经验词典"(AED),将历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入来支持技能再利用并模拟跨任务关系. 具体地说,我们首先将历史动作集合起来,与视觉观察相配合,并使用预先训练的动作指示器从AED取回嵌入动作. 随后,我们通过交叉注意力来视像地调节集合嵌入,并把它们放在吵闹的动作符号上,提供互动背景和行动意图来预测. 为了模拟与动作有关的运动并减少对不相干的背景提示的依赖,我们引入了运动意识过渡损失,通过随机时间间隔来监督视觉特征变化预测. 模拟基准实验和现实世界跨表现环境实验验证了我们的AED的有效性. 匿名项目网站见\href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}。

articles.title: Recognition of Urbanized Areas in UAV-Derived Very-High-Resolution Visible-Light Imagery
articles.content: This study compared classifiers that differentiate between urbanized and non-urbanized areas based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-acquired RGB imagery. The tested solutions in-cluded numerous vegetation indices (VIs) thresholding and neural networks (NNs). The analysis was conducted for two study areas for which surveys were carried out using different UAVs and cameras. The ground sampling distances for the study areas were 10 mm and 15 mm, respectively. Reference classification was performed manually, obtaining approximately 24 million classified pix-els for the first area and approximately 3.8 million for the second. This research study included an analysis of the impact of the season on the threshold values for the tested VIs and the impact of image patch size provided as inputs for the NNs on classification accuracy. The results of the con-ducted research study indicate a higher classification accuracy using NNs (about 96%) compared with the best of the tested VIs, i.e., Excess Blue (about 87%). Due to the highly imbalanced nature of the used datasets (non-urbanized areas constitute approximately 87% of the total datasets), the Mat-thews correlation coefficient was also used to assess the correctness of the classification. The analysis based on statistical measures was supplemented with a qualitative assessment of the classification results, which allowed the identification of the most important sources of differences in classification between VIs thresholding and NNs.

articles.title_zh: 承认无人驾驶飞行器演化甚高分辨率可见光图像中的城市化地区
articles.content_zh: 这项研究比较了根据无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)获得的RGB图像对城市化和非城市化地区加以区分的分类器。 所测试的解决方案不包含许多植被指数阈值和神经网络。 对使用不同无人驾驶航空器和相机进行调查的两个研究领域进行了分析。 研究区的地面取样距离分别为10毫米和15毫米。 参考分类是人工进行的,第一区获得大约2 400万个分类像素,第二区获得大约380万个。 这项研究包括分析该季对被测试VI的阈值的影响以及作为NN输入提供的图像补丁大小对分类准确性的影响。 分解研究的结果显示,使用NNs(约96%)的分类精度高于所测试的VI中最优秀的,即过量蓝(约87%). 由于所使用数据集的高度不平衡性质(非城市化地区约占数据集总数的87%),马特-修斯相关系数也被用于评估分类的正确性. 以统计计量为基础的分析还辅以对分类结果的质量评估,从而得以查明VIs阈值和NNs之间分类差异的最重要来源。

articles.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
articles.content: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, and retrievable memories. MemOpt consistently improves MemLife by 2.7--5.0% across different video and question distributions, with gains that generalize across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.

articles.title_zh: MemLife: 长期爱高中心视频记忆的校正与理性
articles.content_zh: 长期以自我为中心的视频使得个性化的AI助手能够对日常生活进行理性的思考. 然而,随着影视历史持续数月或数年地增长到数百小时,每个查询的后处理生片段在计算上变得令人无法接受。 内存系统通过将视频收缩到文本表达中,提供了一个可扩展的替代方案,但往往在实用基准上失败:要么内存不保存关键证据,要么检索器由于在不断扩大的搜索空间中检索竞争而未能找到相关条目. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了MemLife,这是一个多模式记忆系统,它构建了实体定位的第一人称文本集,并通过有时间索引的代理读取器取回. 在没有培训或查询时间视频访问的情况下,MemLife在4个长距离基准中比最强的无培训基线提高了4.6%-12.0%。 为了进一步提高记忆质量,我们提出"记忆"(Memopt),这个强化的学习框架,优化了记忆作家,以产生忠实,信息化,可检索的记忆. MemOpt持续改善MemLife,在不同的视频和问题发布中以2.7%-5.0%的速度实现,其收益在编剧和读者骨干和内存系统中得到概括.

articles.title: Prototype-Rule Neurosymbolic Regularization for Rank-Constrained Tensor Neural Networks under Label Scarcity
articles.content: Rank-constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high-order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype-rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit arises from training-time regularization, whereas inference fusion is small and dataset dependent.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Label Scarcity下的Rand-Conserted Tensor神经网络的原型-Rule Neurosymbolic规范化
articles.content_zh: 收缩的收缩式收缩式神经网络会降低高序输入的参数化,但它们并没有在所学表现中明确限制类几何. 本研究调查了不同原型规则能否在有限监督下为Rank-R loror学习提供辅助诱导偏差. 拟议框架以基于原型的规范化和可选引信原型证据与神经对数推论,增强了Rank-R目标。 4个超光谱基准在7倍分层和空间相分离的折叠下通过4个Rank-R配置进行评估,以减少渗漏;另外一项空间研究将类别支助预算从2个样本到20个样本不等。 在空间评价下,完整的神经相通推论会改变Macro-F1的得分,博茨瓦纳的得分为+8.82分,印度松的得分为+5.49分,帕维亚大学为+1.59分,萨利纳斯为-0.62分. 大部分好处来自培训时间的正规化,而推论融合则很小,而且取决于数据集。

articles.title: VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning
articles.content: Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains. Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an $11.33\%$ relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VR-JEPA:关于基于一代的视频推理的学习对照-状态初级指南
articles.content_zh: 通过视频生成实现理性,通过模拟潜在的视觉状态及其动态,为视觉智能提供了一条充满希望的道路。 然而,目前的视频生成模型往往缺乏关于这些状态应如何演变的明确指导,使得所生成的轨迹容易被物理和结构上不一致所破坏推理可靠性. 虽然Video Joint-Embedding Presidentive Architecture(V-JEPA)提供了从潜伏预测中吸取的丰富的瞬间前传,但这些一般前传并不自然适应复杂视觉任务所需的逻辑推理能力. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议VR-JEPA,这个框架通过局部对比态学习使V-JEPA预测器与任务特定推理逻辑相配合,并利用其所预测的潜在轨迹指导视频生成进行视觉推理. 具体地说,(一)我们在相同的输入条件下,将成功的轨迹与生成的替代品相配,并在其V-JEPA表述中采用相差之处,以确定信息丰富的状态和用于局部对比性监督的标志. (二) 我们进一步为V-JEPA预测员配备受过锚地任务数据培训的专门技能专家,使该模型能够适应性地专门处理不同认知领域共享的先兆。 与技能特异性专家一道,这种对比性监督使VR-JEPA能够预测潜在的轨迹,为视频生成提供特定任务逻辑指导. 大型VBVR-Pro-Bench数据集的全面实验表明,VR-JEPA比起最前沿的以发电为基础的推理基线,实现了11.33美元相较改进,显著地减轻了物理文物,提高了逻辑一致性.

articles.title: GateSPINE: Gated Cross-View Fusion for Lumbar Spine MRI Report Generation
articles.content: Automated report generation can ease the burden radiolo gists face when interpreting multi-sequence MRI studies. Unlike CT, MRI examinations comprise multiple sequences and imaging planes, each con tributing complementary diagnostic information. Existing methods en code a study as a single volume and combine multiple acquisitions by fixed rules. Findings visible in only one plane are thus diluted and of ten missed, lowering recall on clinical efficacy metrics, where a missed abnormality is most costly. We propose GateSPINE, a vision-language framework that fuses sagittal T1 and T2 volumes with a training-free operator, encodes the fused sagittal and axial volumes with two parallel 3D encoders, and decodes their combined representation into a report. Its core mechanism is a gated cross view fusion module that predicts, per feature channel and token, how much of each view to admit, so the more informative view dominates at each spatial location. We evaluate GateSPINE on three lumbar MRI datasets, comprising two public bench marks and a private cohort collected from Phenikaa University Hospital, using both natural language generation (NLG) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. GateSPINE achieves the highest CE F1 through improved re call on all three datasets; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism, which is validated on the two cohorts with both imaging planes. GateSPINE also remains competitive on standard NLG metrics.

articles.title_zh: GateSPINE: Lumbar Spine MRI 报告生成的 Gated Cross-View Fusion
articles.content_zh: 在解释多序列核磁共振研究时,自动生成报告可以减轻放射性腺素面临的负担。 与CT不同,核磁共振检查由多序列和成像平面组成,每组组成互补诊断信息. 现有方法将研究编码为一卷并按固定规则合并多种获取。 因此,只有一平面上可见的发现被稀释并漏掉10个,降低了临床疗效指标的召回率,而错失的异常最昂贵。 我们提议采用GateSPINE这一视觉语言框架,将T1和T2卷与无训练操作器相接,用两个平行的3D编码器来编码被保险的平面和轴线卷,并将其综合表述解码为一份报告。 它的核心机制是一个有门的交叉视图聚变模块,它预测,每个特性通道和符号,每个视图要承认多少,所以每个空间位置的信息性更强的视角占主导地位. 我们对GateSPINE的3个立体核磁共振数据集进行评估,包括两个公共长凳标记和一个从Phenikaa大学医院收集的私人组群,同时使用自然语言生成(NLG)和临床疗效(CE)衡量标准。 GateSPINE通过改进对所有三个数据集的再调用,实现了最高的CE F1;在缺乏轴序的天基信息平台上,这反映了星形聚变组件,而不是有门的交叉视距机制,在两组有两种成像平面的相机上验证. GateSPINE在标准NLG指标上也保持竞争力.

articles.title: Tissue Detection Determines False Positives in Diffusion-Based Histopathology Artifact Detection
articles.content: One-class artifact detectors for whole-slide images learn normal tissue from a clean training pool and flag departures from it. The pool is built by a preprocessing pipeline whose tissue-detection step is usually treated as neutral. We tested whether it is. On 16 annotated TCGA slides, we rebuilt the clean pool of a diffusion-based detector with different tissue detection methods and compared the resulting models in a four-fold cross-validation. Per-slide saturation-Otsu detection excluded normal tissue, chiefly tissue with large clear spaces such as adipose tissue and alveolar parenchyma, and on slides with thick marker ink kept the ink while excluding ordinary tissue. Replacing it with entropy-based detection reduced the false-positive fraction on held-out clean slides from 0.102 to 0.016, in every fold and with a second training seed, without loss of sensitivity; the gain came from the composition of the pool, not its size. Across three tissue detection methods, false positives followed the fraction of such clear-space tissue in the pool, a statistic that needs no labels or training (0.103, 0.016 and 0.009). The effect did not carry over at the same size to a nearest-neighbour detector on foundation-model features. On an external cohort, the curated pool lowered clean-control false positives by about 20%, far less than within TCGA, and the remaining cross-center loss was not explained by stain differences. For one-class quality control, tissue detection decides what the model learns as normal and should be chosen and reported accordingly.

articles.title_zh: 组织检测确定基于扩散的病理学中的假阳性
articles.content_zh: 全滑成像的一等文物探测器从一清一色的训练池中学习出正常的组织,从中取出旗帜. 游泳池由预处理管来建造,其组织检测步骤通常被视作中性. 我们测试了它是否是。 在16个注解的TCGA幻灯片上,我们重建了具有不同组织检测方法的以扩散为基础的探测器的清洁池并比较了产生的模型,进行了四倍的交叉验证. 平滑饱和-Otsu检测排除了正常组织,主要组织有大面积的清晰空间,如脂肪组织和alveolar parenchyma等;在有厚标墨的滑行上保留了墨水而排除了普通组织. 取而代之的是以肽为基质的检测,将被搁置的清洁滑行上虚假阳性分数从0.102分降至0.016分,每回折叠并有第二个训练种子,不失去灵敏度;收益来自游泳池的成分,而不是其大小. 在三种组织检测方法中,假阳性跟踪池中这种清晰空间组织的分量,这一统计数据不需要标签或训练(0.103、0.016和0.009)。 该效应没有以同样大小延续到地基模型特征上最近的邻居探测器. 在外部群体中,管理池将清洁控制假阳性降低约20%,远远低于TCGA内部,剩下的交叉中心损失没有被污点差异所解释. 对于一等的质量控制,组织检测决定模型的学习是正常的,应当选择并相应报告.

articles.title: LongEmo: Towards Emotion Understanding and Reasoning in Long Videos
articles.content: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in affective computing, their reasoning capabilities are largely confined to short video clips with limited interactions. However, real-world emotions are not merely isolated instantaneous reactions but dynamic and cumulative processes deeply shaped by past experiences and ongoing events. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongEmoBench, a benchmark dedicated to emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. It assesses progressive capabilities scaling from continuous scene interactions to complex episodic developments. Furthermore, we propose LongEmo, a novel memory-augmented agentic framework designed to tackle the immense challenges of long-range affective reasoning. LongEmo processes continuous video streams to construct an Event Memory Graph, explicitly modeling long-range dependencies and capturing emotional dynamics across discrete events. Given a question, the agent retrieves a query-relevant event stream from the graph, iteratively integrating multimodal memories and relational dependencies to deduce the final answer. Extensive evaluations of 17 representative methods reveal that they struggle significantly with emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. In contrast, LongEmo achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the efficacy of its event-centric memory architecture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 长 Emo:在长视频中实现情感理解和理性
articles.content_zh: 虽然最近的多式大语言模型(MLLMs)在活性计算中表现出了希望,但其推理能力基本上局限于互动有限的短视频片段. 然而,现实世界的情绪不仅仅是孤立的即时反应,而是由过去的经验和正在发生的事件所深刻塑造的动态和累积过程。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了LongEmo Bench,这是在长视频中致力于情感理解和推理的基准. 它评估从连续的场景互动向复杂的零星发展扩展的渐进能力。 此外,我们提出LongEmo,这是一个新的记忆强化剂框架,旨在应对长期情感推理的巨大挑战。 长 Emo处理连续的视频流来构建事件记忆图,明确模拟远程依赖性,并捕捉到不同离散事件之间的情感动态. 给出一个问题,代理从图中检索出一个与查询相关的事件流,迭代地将多模式记忆和关系依赖性融合在一起来推断最终答案. 对17个代表性方法的广泛评价表明,它们在长视频中与情感理解和推理发生重大斗争. 相形之下,LongEmo实现了最先进的性能,展示了其以事件为中心的记忆架构的功效.

articles.title: Less Data, Better Timing: Student-Curriculum Coupling for VLM On-Policy Distillation in Temporal Video Grounding
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student's current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. Supervision can therefore be activated, suspended, or reactivated as competence changes, concentrating teacher computation and optimization on current task-level deficits. Across three TVG benchmarks, SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD on its original curriculum, while using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%. Ablations support the complementary roles of capability-structured curriculum design and student-dependent supervision in achieving these gains. Together, these results establish SCC as a data- and compute-efficient framework for TVG post-training, delivering stronger temporal grounding by aligning trustworthy supervision with the student's evolving learning needs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 减少数据, 更好的时间选择: 学生- Curriculum Coupling for VLM On- Policy districtation in Timoral Video Grounding
articles.content_zh: 政策上分馏(OPD)直接对学生生成的轨迹进行密集的监督,使其成为时间视频地平面(TVG)中视觉语言模型的有效培训后战略. 然而,现有管道通常从固定教师和初始学生状态中构建培训课程,隐含地假设选定的实例在整个优化过程中保持了积极的监督价值。 我们表明,监督的可靠性和监督的必要性是不同的,但两者是相辅相成的:前者涉及目标可信度,而后者则与学生目前的任务能力不同;两者共同塑造了监督的价值。 基于这种结合的观点,我们引入了学生-Curriculum Coupling(SCC),这是一种封闭式框架,其中紧凑的Anchor-Frontier课程定义了候选监督空间,而不断发展的学生动态地决定其活动子集. 因此,随着能力的变化,可以启动、中止或恢复监督,将教师的计算和优化集中在目前的任务一级缺陷上。 在三个TVG基准中,SCC在最初课程中比Video-OPD的平均召回率提高了5.1%,同时使用的培训实例减少了60.0%,培训时间减少了50.4%。 拨款支持能力结构课程设计和依靠学生的监督在实现这些成果方面的互补作用。 这些结果共同将SCC确立为TVG后培训的数据和计算效率框架,通过将可信赖的监督与学生不断变化的学习需要相配合,提供更强大的时间基础。

articles.title: CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding
articles.content: Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities. Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy-tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters. During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations. Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition. Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model. Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy-tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.

articles.title_zh: ECEvo When: 超长视频时间定位政策工具
articles.content_zh: 超长视频时间定位需要在有限视觉预算下平衡远程证据搜索和精细事件理解,而现有的代理方法仍然在很大程度上依赖于预先定义的政策和工具能力. 以此为动力,我们提出一个新的政策工具共进框架,共同从VLM的代理推理轨迹中演化出高层次政策和可执行的媒体工具,形成可重复使用的技能而无需更新模型参数. 在进化过程中,外出技能更新器在长视频时段地平面上提炼出可转移的任务经验,并据此完善了长程图像和细纹视频观测的管弦. 除了这些政策更新之外,更新器还利用其编码能力来更新现有工具或创建新工具,使工具适应长视频证据的获取。 VLM与演化后的技能相匹配,在演化后的政策指导下自主地协调了各种工具,协调了图像和视频观察,用于代理推论,而没有依赖一个单独的更强大的规划模式. 跨越5个基准和3个VLM的广泛实验表明,政策工具的协同演进不断提高超长视频的时间定位精度,同时在推论中降低视觉符号成本,演化后的技能在一般的长视频QA上产生显著的性能收益而无需额外的特定任务演进,显示了我们框架对于长视频理解的有效性和可概括性.

articles.title: MAGiDiff: Sampling the Photospheric Vector Field from UV/EUV Filtergrams
articles.content: Photospheric vector magnetic fields are foundational to modeling, understanding, and forecasting solar activity. These data are usually produced by inverting and disambiguating the full Stokes vector at multiple passbands, which is demanding. Here, we investigate how well we can estimate photospheric vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. This problem is challenging and intrinsically ambiguous without polarization information, as the mapping from UV/EUV intensity to the magnetic field is indirect and ill-posed. We introduce MAGiDiff, a machine-learning-based method that uses denoising diffusion models to estimate vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. As input, MAGiDiff takes a stack of filtergrams from the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) / Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA); as output, it is trained to estimate the disambiguated vector magnetogram as seen by Hinode / Solar Optical Telescope-Spectro-Polarimeter (SOT-SP). We show that MAGiDiff can accurately mimic the Hinode ground-truth. Additionally, we probe MAGiDiff's understanding of the physical structure and magnetic connectivity. On full-disk, we show that it produces plausible structures for active regions. MAGiDiff generalizes across solar cycles despite hemispheric polarity reversal, and can be fine-tuned to other EUV instruments including STEREO/EUVI and GOES-R/SUVI. While clearly not a substitute for a dedicated instrument, MAGiDiff opens the door to new capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MAGiDiff:从紫外线/欧盟紫外线过滤器中取样平流层矢量场
articles.content_zh: 平流层向量磁场是太阳活动的建模、理解和预测的基础。 这些数据通常是通过在多段传行带上颠倒并分解全斯托克斯向量来生成的,这要求很高. 在这里,我们调查我们如何能从紫外线/欧盟紫外线滤波仪中 估算出光球向量磁力。 这个问题具有挑战性,而且内在含糊不清,没有极化信息,因为从紫外线/欧盟紫外线强度到磁场的绘图是间接的,而且不可靠。 我们引入了MAGiDiff,一种基于机器学习的方法,它使用去诺能扩散模型来估计从紫外/欧盟紫外线滤波图中产生的矢量磁学. 作为输入,MAGiDiff从太阳动力学观测站(SDO)/大气成像仪(AIA)中取出一叠过滤克;作为输出,它经过了培训,可以估算出由Hinode / Solar Optical Telescope-Spectro-Polarimeter(SOT-SP)所看到的分解的矢量磁图. 我们显示MAGiDiff能够准确地模仿Hinode地面真实性. 此外,我们探索了MAGiDiff对物理结构和磁通性的理解. 在全磁盘上,我们显示,它为活跃地区创造了可信的结构。 MAGiDiff尽管半球极性反转,但仍能对太阳各周期进行通俗化,并可被微调成其他欧盟V仪器,包括STEREO/EUVI和GOES-R/SUVI. 虽然显然不能替代专用仪器,但MAGiDiff打开了新能力的大门.

articles.title: Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation
articles.content: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian, a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 to 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features.

articles.title_zh: 通过反向分泌增强自递视频生成
articles.content_zh: 很少步骤自回式视频生成可以实现高效的流体合成,但早期时间块中引入的错误作为上下文被再用,并且可以通过随后的推出来传播,导致细节降解,结构漂移和不稳定的运动. 现有的发行配对蒸馏(DMD)主要在扩散潜伏空间对学生和教师的发行进行配对,但对解码视频的感知质量没有直接监督. 我们引入了Radian,一种代表-空间对抗式提炼框架,在被冷冻的视觉地基模型(VFM)所定义的地物空间中,用真实数据对抗式监督来补充政策DMD. 在训练期间,拉地安稀疏地从自发式学生推出中解码帧,取出多层次的视觉表现,并应用轻量级歧义头来区分生成的输出与真实的视频帧. DMD目标将学生锁定在被预训的老师身上,而表现-空间对抗目标则提供互补的知觉和语义梯度来推广高质量的模式. 这些额外组成部分在培训后被放弃,使发电机结构和推论时间不改变预算。 Wan2.1-1.3B上的实验涵盖四相分块,一相框相接,并有分分钟的自递生成. 我们的方法在"四步生成"下实现了"V Bench"总计0.8444和"VideoAlign"总计0.8033,并改进了"V Bench-Long"从"0.7805"到"0.8041"的"滚出堡",同时使用较少的去名步骤. 对图像、视频和传播表现方式的可控比较进一步表明,代表空间的选择诱发不同的对抗信号,外部的VFM梯度比传播-内部特征产生的对抗性监督更有效地补充DMD。

articles.title: WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks
articles.content:
Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria.
  We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classical, deep, and generative watermarking methods, as well as 34 different erasing techniques, ranging from traditional distortions to more sophisticated adversarial, purification, and re-embedding attacks. It provides standardized, reproducible, and easily scalable protocols for evaluating perceptual quality, watermark readability, and attack resilience.
  Using WARP, we extensively evaluate current invisible watermarking techniques, collecting the largest robustness benchmark in the field. Results identify the most robust approaches under both distortion and adversarial conditions, and reveal consistent relationships between watermarking methods and the attack strategies most effective against them. Our experiments also highlight that some of the watermarking methods considered are highly vulnerable to reembedding, even if they are robust to standard distortions. The code is made available at https://github.com/ispras/wibe.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WARP: 无形图像水标记的统一基准 -- -- 强健和防范攻击
articles.content_zh:
数字图像水标记在媒体环境中越来越重要,因为新出现的条例和行业做法要求标识AI生成的内容,并确保可追踪来源,以防止被操纵或被滥用。 隐形水标方法最近的进展突出表明需要更新现有的基准做法,以反映目前的技术和评价标准。
我们通过采用WARP来解决这个问题 -- -- 一个统一的框架和基准,用以评估无形水印的坚固性。 WARP包含了最近32个古典、深层和分族的水分标记方法以及34个不同的去除技术,从传统的扭曲到更复杂的对抗、净化和再嵌入攻击。 它提供了标准化、可复制和易于扩展的协议,用于评价能见性质量、可读性以及攻击复原力。
使用WARP,我们广泛评价了目前的隐形水分标记技术,收集了该领域最大的稳健度基准. 结果查明了在扭曲和对抗条件下最有力的办法,并揭示了水标记方法和最有效的攻击战略之间的一贯关系。 我们的实验还突出表明,某些水标记方法即使对标准扭曲很强,也极易被重新嵌入。 该守则可在https://github.com/ispras/wibe上查阅。

articles.title: Can We Anticipate Violence? Multimodal Learning from Pre-Incident Behavioral Cues
articles.content: Detecting violence after it begins is important from recognizing behavioral cues that appear immediately beforehand. This work studies short-horizon pre-incident risk recognition from multimodal video signals. We construct a binary Normal-versus-Risky setting from temporally annotated XD-Violence clips, using 443 samples with source-level separation across training, validation, and test sets. Each sample consists of a variable-length pre-incident clip, with its duration determined by the observable behavioral context preceding the incident. The inci- dent itself is excluded from all input clips. We evaluate three complementary information sources: facial-region appearance, temporally aligned audio, and body-motion features derived from tracked keypoints. Controlled ablations are performed with Swin-Tiny, ViT-Tiny, and DeiT-Tiny to measure the contribution of each modality under the same split. Results show that combining all modalities is more effective than using any other combination alone. The best configuration, Deit-Tiny with audio, facial appearance, and motion, achieves 91.21% accuracy, 88.96% balanced accuracy, 93.65% F1-score, and 96.38% ROC-AUC on the held-out test set. These results suggest that complementary appearance, acoustic, and kinematic cues provide useful evidence for recognizing elevated pre-incident risk.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我们能想象暴力吗? 从事前行为库学习多种模式
articles.content_zh: 在暴力开始后发现暴力,重要的是要认识到立即出现的行为提示。 这项工作研究了从多模式视频信号中识别事故前风险的短视. 我们用时间标注的XD-暴力片段构建一个二进制的常态对Risky设置,使用443个样本,在培训、验证和测试集之间进行源层分离。 每个样本由可变长的事故前剪辑组成,其持续时间由事发前可观察到的行为上下文决定. 缩进本身被排除在所有输入片段之外. 我们评价了三个互补的信息来源:面部-区域外观、时间上一致的音频和从有轨钥匙点衍生出的身体运动特征。 与Swin-Tiny、ViT-Tiny和DeiT-Tiny一起进行受控活化,以测量在同一个分法下每种模式的贡献。 结果表明,将所有模式结合起来比单独使用任何其他组合更为有效。 最佳配置Deit-Tiny 配有音频,面部外观和运动,实现91.21%的精度,88.96%的平衡精度,93.65%的F1-分数,96.38%的ROC-AUC在被搁置的测试集上. 这些结果表明,相辅外观、声学和动能提示为识别高发事前风险提供了有益的证据。

articles.title: Multi-Link Safety Filtering for VLA Policies Around Moving Hazards
articles.content: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid's center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from $65.62\%$ to $27.27\%$ and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from $29.35\%$ to $50.43\%$. Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in $2.2$~ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision--language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each $π_{0.5}$ policy call on the integrated GPU from $343$ to $177.3$~ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 围绕移动危险进行VLA政策的多链接安全过滤
articles.content_zh: 愿景语言行动(VLA)政策可以在敲打与其无关的物体的同时完成操控任务,因此单凭任务成功并不能表明该政策是安全部署在杂乱状态. 我们研究如何在不进行再培训的情况下保持预先训练的越战法政策在运行期间消除这些危险,这需要随着危险发生,在危险发生后,更多地守护手臂而不是最终效应器,并分享船上计算的政策。 我们的无训练防护罩覆盖了抓取器、手腕和前臂,上面有5个椭圆形,并且通过一个屏障程序过滤出每个受指示的运动,以抵消在重置时从RGB-D感知处安装的保持椭圆形。 Sparse光学流随同危险带去椭圆体中心,没有再被探测或再接再励. 超过6个模拟危险-运动条件,盾牌将相撞从65.62美元降低到27.27美元并提升安全成功,任务完成而无相撞,从29.35美元降低到50.43美元. 缺损表明,守臂链保护范围超越了终端效应屏蔽,而追踪恢复了在重置时危险估计被冻结时损失的大部分保护. 在多面的边缘硬件上,5-椭圆形屏障在CPU上以每分之九十九的2.2美元~毫秒的速度运行,并缩小视觉语言前缀并减少流量匹配步骤,将每个$~0.5}$对综合GPU的政策呼吁从343美元到177.3美元~毫秒缩短. 在横跨四项任务的一具SO-101臂上,手臂在16个被屏蔽的事件中有3起触出危险,而16个被屏蔽的事件中有11起触出危险。 项目网页:https://yathag.github.io/多链接-安全-过滤器

articles.title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
articles.content: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重建动态 世界:4D场景重建的代表景
articles.content_zh: 4D场景重建旨在从视觉观测中恢复动态环境不断发展的几何,外观和运动. 尽管在神经场景表现上取得了实质性进展,但由于非刚性运动,被隔离,时间不一致,以及重建忠心与计算效率之间的取舍,重建动态场景仍然具有挑战性. 最近神经辐射场(NERF)和3D高斯平板化(3DGS)的进步引入了代表并重建动态场景的多种方法,然而它们之间的关系,基础设计选择和评价协议仍然支离破碎. 在本文中,我们提出了4D场景重建的统一视角,围绕他们的场景表现,时间建模策略,重建管线,优化目标,组织现有方法. 通过这个框架,我们研究不同的设计选择如何影响几何忠诚,外观的一致性,运动表现和计算效率. 我们进一步整合常用数据集和评价指标,找出当前实验做法的局限性,并讨论重建复杂而活泼的现实世界环境的公开挑战. 通过将方法发展与其基本假设和评价证据联系起来,这项工作为理解现有方法和确定未来的研究方向提供了有条理的基础。 有关论文和资源不断演变的汇编可在https://github.com/Ziyang Yan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction上查阅。

articles.title: Learning to Reason with Compressed Context: Ground-Truth-Free Adaptation of OmniLLMs via Self-Distillation
articles.content: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) enable unified audio-video understanding, but their long multimodal token sequences make deployment computationally expensive. Token compression reduces this cost, yet aggressive compression often lowers accuracy. Existing works predominantly focus on designing better compression mechanisms; however, adapting the underlying language model to reason effectively over the remaining compressed context remains under-explored. To address this, we propose CAFD (Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation), a ground-truth-free self-distillation framework that adapts OmniLLMs to fixed compression pipelines without requiring reference answers, rationales, or correctness rewards. CAFD leverages the full-token view of the same multimodal sample as a source of privileged information: a full-context self-teacher provides soft target supervision to a compressed-context student along the student's on-policy trajectory. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B across five audio-video benchmarks, five compression pipelines, and five deployment budgets, CAFD demonstrates consistent gains, improving 120 out of 125 conditions with an average accuracy boost of 1.44 points and recovering 26.9% of the accuracy gap on average. These results demonstrate that the proposed ground-truth-free adaptation offers an effective and practical route to improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployed OmniLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在压缩背景下学习理性:通过自我扭曲实现OmniLLM的地-真理-自由适应
articles.content_zh: Omni-module大型语言模型(OmniLLMs)能够实现统一的音频-视频理解,但是它们的长多模式符号序列使得部署在计算上昂贵. Token压缩降低了这一成本,然而积极的压缩往往会降低准确度. 现有工作主要侧重于设计更好的压缩机制;然而,使基本语言模型有效解释其余压缩上下文的问题仍然没有得到充分探讨。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出CAFD(通过Full-Context Distillation进行压缩-Context District),这是一个无地真相的自沉框架,它使OmniLLMs适应固定压缩管道,而不需要参考答案、理由或正确性回报。 CAFD利用同一多模式样本的全能观点作为特权信息来源:一个全能的自导师沿着学生的政策轨迹向一个被压缩的自导体学生提供软目标监督. 对Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的评价涉及5个音频视频基准、5个压缩管道和5个部署预算,CAFD显示出持续的收益,在125个条件中改进了120个条件,平均准确度提升1.44分,平均恢复了26.9%的准确度差距。 这些结果表明,拟议的无地真相适应为改进所部署的OmniLLMs的精确效率取舍提供了一个有效而实际的途径。

articles.title: LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception
articles.content: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.

articles.title_zh: LEAP: 为长音频视频感知获取基于块的学习证据
articles.content_zh: 小时级的视听问题回答受到上下文困境的制约:密集的全记录编码快速地耗尽了上下文的限制,而统一的时间压缩会严重地稀释精细的声学和视觉证据. 我们引入了LEAP,一个模型在不将整个记录放在一个上下文的情况下获取自己证据的框架. LEAP将一个录音分为固定的长度块,在每个块应用一个轻量级本地化的通行证来分出短候选窗口. 排名最高的窗口被集合并被重新编码在一个单一的有界限的接通接通中. 因此,答案输入和峰值背景仍然独立于记录期限。 通过将证据本地化与推理脱钩,我们的框架可以将候选时间窗口定位于预编译的文字记录而无需解码媒体框,同时通过将最终的回答传递到原始视听流上来来保存精细的视觉和非语音证据. LEAP列车分为两个阶段:一个本地化LORA改进了所选窗口,一个答案LORA改进了从同一窗口读取的答案. 块网格在本土上支持因果查询,使得LEAP能够支持流入推论而无需流出特定训练. 在许多AVQA基准中,LEAP比Qun3-Omni-30B-A3B基准改进了4.5-16.8%,并转至第二个全方位模式主干线MiniCPM-o 4.5,比公布的结果高出了3.1-13.0%。

articles.title: Reliability-Aware Checkpoint Selection for Domain Generalization
articles.content: Checkpoint selection in domain generalization often relies on source-validation accuracy, yet the selected checkpoint need not provide reliable probabilities on unseen target domains. Source-target distribution shifts can alter accuracy rankings, while accuracy alone does not measure predictive probability quality. We identify an empirical selection opportunity within fixed training trajectories: reselecting among checkpoints with near-optimal source accuracy can improve mean target probability quality with small observed changes in mean target accuracy. We study accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which retains checkpoints within a tolerance of the best source-validation accuracy and ranks them by source reliability. Our reference rule aggregates within-set normalized negative log-likelihood (NLL) and class-wise calibration error (CwECE) using $D_\infty$. AC uses no target data and requires neither additional training nor weight averaging. We evaluate five domain generalization training algorithms on three benchmarks, using PACS to develop the objectives and a 0.5-percentage-point tolerance. In exploratory aggregation comparisons on 360 OfficeHome and TerraIncognita runs, the reference rule reduces mean target soft-bin squared-gap ECE and CwECE by 0.240% and 0.182%, respectively, and NLL by 0.030 relative to Source-Acc. Mean target accuracy changes by +0.213 percentage points. These results identify opportunities for reliability-aware reselection, while the additional benefit of joint over single-objective ranking remains unresolved.
